_comment: Board Setup minimums for Inty-FujiCard.kicad_pro.  KiCad applies these as an absolute floor that no custom rule can lower, so each one is the lowest value Yannick Erb's copper needs (measured, README 'Design rules'); Inty-FujiCard.kicad_dru then holds every item to JLCPCB's standard 1-2 layer figures (kicad-happy jlcpcb 2.2.1: 0.127 mm space, 0.45 / 0.2 mm via, 0.125 mm ring, 0.3 mm to the edge) except the measured exceptions it names.
